name: Skilled Crews
summary: Friendly Aeldari Vehicle units' ranged weapons gain the Assault ability.

name: Strength from Death
summary: Ynnari may join despite lacking the faction keyword, led by Yvraine and/or The Yncarne; Asuryani units gain the Ynnari keyword. Grants bonus moves on a Ynnari death, a Fade Back, or an enemy Fall Back, plus Fights First for a battered unit.

name: Defend at All Costs
summary: Dire Avenger, Guardian, Support Weapon, and War Walker attacks get +1 to hit when the attacker or its target is within range of an objective marker.

name: Far-Reaching Doom
summary: While a Rangers or Shroud Runners unit is shooting, enemy detection range against it is increased by 6" until it finishes shooting.

name: Strands of Fate
summary: Roll a pool of Fate dice at the start of the battle (more at larger battle sizes). Discard a die matching a specific Stratagem's value to cut that use's cost by 1CP.

name: Dance of Distortion
summary: Friendly Harlequins units gain Stealth. This detachment carries the exclusive Acrobatic tag.

name: Ride the Wind
summary: Aeldari Mounted and Vyper units can start in, or return late to, Strategic Reserves and arrive a battle round early, up to a battle-size-limited count. Windriders units gain the Battleline keyword.
